headline_source: measurements/p1/round-4/headline.json, written by applying the rule in sieve.md to the sieve's published cells. It is NOT a list this file may edit afterwards: this file freezes the candidates and the selection rule, the sieve produces the numbers, and the derived list is committed before the first cell of the COMPARISON runs. A headline set chosen any other way after a number exists is the defect the whole directory is built against.
arms_note: The pair the round is about is `mnema-doc` against `mnema+`, which differ in one switch position. `base` is the regression check that blocks every other row, and it is why round 3 could read anything at all. `host` is carried because it is the arm that has beaten or tied the product in every round so far and dropping it would make this the first round that cannot say where the product stands against what is already installed.
n_note: Eight runs per (task, arm) for the comparison, against round 3's four. The reason is power and it is measured, not asserted: `measurements/p1/threshold.md` derives the threshold per SHAPE, and at ten tasks the move from four runs to eight is what takes the round from seeing a 15-point effect 11% of the time to seeing it 47% of the time. The sieve runs eight for a different reason, in sieve.md.
development_criterion: the pilot is the lowest-numbered axis-A task; the second development task is the lowest-numbered axis-A task whose discriminant runs on a runtime the pilot's does not. Stated here rather than inherited, and it is round 3's own criterion re-applied: a23's discriminant is PHP and a24's is Python, so the pair is fixed by the rule and not by what the tasks contain.
rule: held-out tasks are touched once by the COMPARISON, and no task is edited after any result of this round exists. The sieve is the one declared exception and it is not a loophole: it runs the sixteen candidates on one arm before the comparison, its cells are discarded and never counted, and it selects tasks WITHOUT editing them. What remains forbidden, and is what `touched once` protects, is changing a task, a digest, this split or the reading after seeing any number.
